critical_code_review_comments: observe.py: _next_node_id() uses count_documents — same race / id-reuse-after-delete concern flagged in iter8 for lattice.py. Two concurrent /observe watch requests can collide on the same NODE-XXXX id. Consider an atomic findOneAndUpdate counter document (e.g., db.althea_counters) shared by observe.py and lattice.py.
observe.py has its own _next_node_id() helper that duplicates lattice.py — extract into utils.py to remove DRY violation and keep id-allocation policy single-sourced.

observe.py pattern_snippet = interpretation.split('\n')[0][:280] silently truncates Claude's reply; consider logging the truncation or storing the full reply in a separate field for richer reflection content.
NeuralCore.jsx polling interval (5s) is hardcoded — consider extracting to a constant or env-driven config so it can be tuned without code edits.
NeuralCore.jsx disposeLatticeGroup() runs every 5s and re-creates all meshes; for hundreds of nodes this allocates churn. Consider keying meshes by node.id and diff-updating instead of full rebuild.
ChatConsole.jsx still ~670 lines (carryover from iter 8 review).
